verdict.rationale: Synthesia's own reusable AI avatars give a persistent character that can present across many videos without repeated filming, and outfits and backgrounds can be changed while keeping the avatar. That is cross-video character persistence rather than one-off reference input. Nothing documents consistency of scenes or characters across separately generated shots in a prompt-to-video flow; the voice-consistency claim covers narration only. Missing for 10: documented multi-shot scene/character consistency in generated footage, consistency of non-avatar characters or environments across shots, independent or hands-on corroboration.

support.subject: As a creator, a character or scene stays consistent across multiple generated shots, not just within one clip

citations.quote: Create a personal or branded AI avatar that can present video content without repeated filming.
Create an avatar of yourself from a single photo, for more personal videos.
Change outfits and background that match your brand and context.
